name: Do not use diagnostic data for tailored experiences
description: Enables the per-user Group Policy 'Do not use diagnostic data for tailored experiences' (User Configuration > Administrative Templates > Windows Components > Cloud Content) by setting DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData = 1 (REG_DWORD) in HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent.
rationale: Stops Windows from using this device's diagnostic data (which may include browser, app and feature usage) to personalize tips, offers and recommendations for the current user.
effects: Windows does not use diagnostic data from this device to customize lock screen content, Windows tips, Microsoft consumer features and related features for the current user.
sideEffects: Recommendations, tips and offers may still appear, but they are not personalized (Microsoft: 'they may be less relevant').
The Tailored experiences option in Settings > Privacy & security > Diagnostics & feedback is managed by the policy for this user.
notes: Policy definition CloudContent.admx, policy DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData (class User): enabled value 1, disabled value 0.
The policy does not control Cortana's tailored experiences, which have separate policies.

HKCU\Software\Policies is normally writable by administrators only, so this per-user rule usually needs an elevated PowerShell run by the same user. WinLean checks the real key permissions instead of assuming.
